name: cro-geo-audit
title: CRO + GEO Audit Toolkit
description: Skill para auditoria autônoma de CRO e GEO em websites.
author: André Almeida

network_egress.reason: Fetches and analyzes the target website, its robots.txt and sitemap, and public AI-search and directory endpoints. Core to a web audit.

subprocess.reason: Calls curl via subprocess with structured argument lists (no shell=True) to measure timing, headers and SSL.

dependency_install.reason: seo_meta_check.py requires requests and beautifulsoup4, installed from a pinned requirements.txt.
